dedupe_keys.name: 和歌山県 洪水浸水想定区域図 小規模河川等 dams reservoirs and flood defences and flood

description: 【和歌山県】洪水浸水想定区域図(小規模河川等) [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 近年、大雨や短時間強雨の発生頻度が増加し、全国各地で毎年のように甚大な洪水被害が発生しています。 このような中、和歌山県では洪水浸水想定区域図を作成・公表しています。 なお、洪水浸水想定区域図は、対象河川の洪水に伴う氾濫を想定していますが、平成23年の紀伊半島大水害で発生したような土石流や流木に起因する河道閉塞による氾濫はその不確実性が高... Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. It offers 3 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
